svg.text: syne1a exon 1α2 in adult zebrafish RNA-seq (GRCz11 chr20, + strand)
Coverage (wild-type reads pooled per tissue, PRJNA1257549) and splice junctions counted per fragment; arcs: giant (grey) and α2 (red)
Exon 1α2 lies in intron 127 of the giant transcript (ENSDART00000139350.4 numbering). Fractions and DV23 inclusion: results/rnaseq/per_fish.tsv.
